joel: Noticed reproducible mismatch on comet-30k int8 around token ~19,780 vs fp16. Short repro attached.

tara: Share the minimal command?

joel: ./run_repro --model comet-30k --quant int8 --prompt tests/long_22k.txt --seed 11
First mismatch token=19782.

indra: Hypothesis: rotary sine/cos table quantization error accumulating over long sequences. Any debug traces?

joel: Enabled ROPE_TRACE:
[rope] idx=19778 phase=0.5178 sin=0.8712 cos=0.4907 qerr=9.1e-4
[rope] idx=19779 phase=0.5180 sin=0.8710 cos=0.4912 qerr=1.8e-3
[rope] mismatch token=19782 kv_key=0x7b2f1a

tara: If kv_key differs, could be precompute vs kernel mismatch. I'll do a kv-hash dump on canary and compare with fp16 run.

indra: I'll push a small kernel change to keep sin/cos in fp16 and promote to fp32 in compute. Locally I saw no drift up to 30k in quick smoke. PR link coming.

vik: Running small eval (longbench-22k) across fp16/int8 for 3 seeds. Will upload CSV to drive. Early numbers: fp16 perp=10.9, int8=15.4, drift concentrated after 19.5k.

ci-bot: Build #8043 for comet-int8 complete  s3://redwood-ci/comet/8043/.

joel: Action items:
- joel: open ISSUE-5077 with repro and traces
- indra: post kernel dump and bisect results
- tara: kv-hash compare between fp16/int8
- vik: full 10-seed eval once quant change lands

indra: Posting WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/comet/pull/88  uses fp16 table approach. Perf delta ~+2.5% token latency.

tara: I'll correlate kv traces; if keys match but values differ we look at serialization/quant memcpy path.

joel: Tagging this high for onboarding. If patch looks safe let's canary tomorrow.

vik: Uploaded initial CSV and token-drift heatmap: https://drive.redwood/comet/longbench/2026-03-23/results.csv

ci-bot: ISSUE-5077 created by joel  https://issues.redwood/5077 (comet-30k int8 longctx drift).

joel: Thanks, keeping thread as source of truth.
